name: foreman-ui
description: Foreman inside Claude Code: a band above the prompt, a docked dashboard pane, toasts and one-press approve/next/drive/inbox actions.

freshAt.title: Compact at task boundaries (context %)
freshAt.description: When a task closes with context at or above this percent, compact so the next task starts fresh. 0 turns it off.

freshTokens.title: Compact at task boundaries (context tokens)
freshTokens.description: When a task closes with at least this many context tokens, compact so the next task starts fresh: every turn re-reads the whole context. 0 turns it off.

mascot.title: Mascot
mascot.description: The animated Claude in the Foreman pane's top-right corner.
